pages.title: Synchronizer Game
pages.text: The Synchronizer Game is a match the beat game, follow the pattern as it approaches the buttons, select the correct button that corresponds to the next colliding beat. The game speeds up every 10 beats.

pages.title: Time Trigger
pages.text: Used to start the game, right-click with it on the Space-Time Synchronizer to spawn an NPC and start the game.

pages.title: Space-Time Trigger
pages.text: The Space-Time Trigger is given for succesfully completing the game.
